name: io.github.blainomd/solvinghealth-data-tools
title: SolvingHealth federal health data
description: Read-only US federal health data with sources: NPI, FDA 510(k), recalls, trials, hospitals.

tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: Search the CMS NPPES NPI registry for clinicians or organizations. Use for "find orthopedic surgeons in Colorado", "orthopaedic surgeons in ZIP 80303", verifying a practice name, or listing a taxonomy in a city. Returns NPI, name, credential, taxonomies with state licenses, addresses and secondary practice locations.

postal_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (or ZIP+4). Matches practice-location addresses, including secondary practice locations

taxonomy.description: Specialty as NPPES words it, e.g. "Orthopaedic Surgery" (British spelling)

first_name.description: Given name of an individual provider

last_name.description: Family name of an individual provider

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Look up one provider by 10-digit NPI. Use to verify an NPI is real, active, and matches the specialty you expect.

tools.name: search_clearances
tools.description: Search FDA 510(k) device clearances (openFDA). Use to check whether a device type has been cleared, who cleared it, and when — e.g. "is there a cleared knee goniometer", "what did Stryker clear since 2024".

tools.name: search_device_recalls
tools.description: Search FDA device recall records. Use for safety history on an implant or device family before citing it.

tools.name: search_adverse_events
tools.description: Search FDA MAUDE device adverse event reports. Use for real-world failure modes reported for a device type.

tools.name: search_drug_labels
tools.description: Search FDA structured drug labeling (SPL) for indications and boxed warnings. Use to check what a drug is labeled for.

tools.name: search_trials
tools.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov (API v2) for registered studies. Use for "what is recruiting for knee OA", evidence landscape questions, or checking whether a claimed trial exists.

location.description: Where the study runs: a state, city or country, e.g. "Colorado"

tools.name: search_hospitals
tools.description: Search the CMS Hospital General Information file: ownership, type, emergency services, and overall star rating.

tools.name: suspension_deadlines
tools.description: Medicare payment suspension: the 15-day rebuttal deadline and the CMS determination deadline from the date on the notice, with the 42 CFR 405.370-405.375 rules quoted from eCFR. A pure calculation; nothing is stored.

notice.description: Date on the suspension notice, YYYY-MM-DD

rebuttal_received.description: Date CMS received the rebuttal, YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List every API endpoint, whether it is live, and which government dataset it reads. Call this first if unsure what data is available — it also names what is deliberately NOT implemented and why, and lists open endpoints that run elsewhere, such as the family caregiver navigator.

tools.name: caregiver_questionnaire
tools.description: Get the questions for ClinicalSwipe's family caregiver navigator: who is being cared for, their coverage, family doctor, what is going on, military service, money and state. Returns each question with its answer codes, plus the full resource catalog, each resource with its official source URL and the date it was checked. format "fhir" returns the FHIR R4 Questionnaire instead. Call this before caregiver_plan so the answers use the codes it lists.

format.description: "json" (default): plain questions and the catalog. "fhir": the FHIR R4 Questionnaire.

tools.name: caregiver_plan
tools.description: Build a family caregiver's plan with ClinicalSwipe's navigator: public programs first, then what to ask the family doctor, then neighbor help, then what is not open yet, labeled as such. Every step names its source page and the date it was checked. A step that needs a clinician says who, what and why, and signs: true marks only the steps a program requires a clinician to sign or certify. General information from official program pages, not medical, legal or financial advice; each program decides its own eligibility. The answers go to clinicalswipe.com, which does not store or log them. Send no names or identifiers.

answers.description: Plain answers keyed by the questionnaire's question ids, using the codes caregiver_questionnaire lists, e.g. {"coverage":"medicare","doctor":"yes","state":"CO","situation":["memory"]}

questionnaire_response.description: A FHIR R4 QuestionnaireResponse to the navigator questionnaire, instead of answers.

format.description: "json" (default) or "fhir" for a FHIR R4 CarePlan. A QuestionnaireResponse always gets a CarePlan.
